info.title: API.SH: Meetup
info.description: The Meetup API from API.SH: public Meetup data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Meetup event: id, title, link, start and end, type (in person or online), status, RSVP state, going and interested counts, trending flag, fee, venue (name, address, city, coordinates), group (name, link, rating) and image; plus description, created date, duration, how to find us, short link, guest policy, hosts, topics, series, refund policy, map link, venue type and the group's member count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meetup-event

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The number in a meetup.com/<group>/events/<id>/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The people who RSVP'd to a Meetup event, as the public attendee list shows them: display name, member id, profile link, photo, bio, RSVP status, host flag, first-event flag, guest count and RSVP time, with the event's title, link and start and the total (for the default `going` list). Filter by status (going, waitlist, attended, all) or hosts only. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meetup-event-attendees

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The event number (or pass `url`, an event link).

parameters.name: hosts_only
parameters.description: true lists the event hosts only.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Meetup events around a place or map point, by keywords (or the site's events-near-you list without keywords), in person or online, in a date range and radius, in a topic category, sorted by relevance or date. Each event: id, title, link, start and end, type (in person or online), status, RSVP state, going and interested counts, trending flag, fee, venue (name, address, city, coordinates), group (name, link, rating) and image. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meetup-events

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A place name, e.g. `New York`, `London`, `Berlin, Germany`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only online or only in-person events.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Events starting on or after (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO date-time).

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Events starting before (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO date-time).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pass `next_cursor` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Meetup group's members as a logged-out visitor sees them: display name, member id, profile link, photo, bio, role (member, organizer, co-organizer, event organizer) and join date, plus the group's total member and leadership counts. Logged out, Meetup returns the earliest-joined members only (up to `limit`) and no further pages; `role=leader` lists the organizers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meetup-group-members

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Meetup groups by words around a city or a map point: name, link, description, city, member count, topics, category, rating and photo. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` (null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/meetup-groups

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to search group names and topics for.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or place name (e.g. `New York`). Use this or latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the search point (use with longitude).

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the search point (use with latitude).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Value of `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
